budget_items.topic: FY2023 town budget and residential share
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Select Board's February 7 press release states the FY2023 town budget total and the portion raised from residential property owners.
budget_items.quote: for fiscal year 2023, the town's budget is $50,144,851.65, of which, $28,618,106.43 is to be raised and appropriated from residential property owners.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A projected deficit in the Health Insurance line from enrollment changes for active employees and retirees; no dollar amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: there will be a projected deficit in the health insurance line this year due to changes in enrollment for both active and retirees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 Snow and Ice budget is over by about $170,000 (printed as '$1 70,000'), which the minutes attribute largely to contractor rates and a salt cost increase of more than 12%; the projected deficit would be covered from the Pavement Management line.
budget_items.quote: the f y 23 snow and ice budget is currently over by approximately $1 70,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chair clarified that the overall budget can only increase by 2½ percent under Proposition 2½; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: discussion ensued about how proposition 2 ½ works. mr. jeffreys clarified the overall budget can only go up 2½ percent.

transfers.description: Snow and ice deficit to be covered within the Pavement Management line, per the Finance Director, DPW Director and Town Manager.
transfers.quote: would be ableto cover the projected deficit within the pavement management line.
